name: netsphere-pro
description: NetSphere Pro - professional, browser-based ISP management platform

scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force }"
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e
